item.title: Week 10: Panthers at Saints
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: NO -1.5 · O/U 48.5 | Model NO 45% vs. market 50% | On paper Carolina has the edge (Carolina's defense ranks 1st in YAC over expected per catch, -0.6 yds allowed), while New Orleans's best counter is to finish drives (New Orleans ranks 11th in red-zone TD rate, 59%). Under center, Bryce Young ranks 14th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Tyler Shough ranks 16th; x-factor: Chris Olave gets 29% of New Orleans' targets and 46% of its air yards, and His WOPR (0.75) ranks 5th of 1211. Carolina's pass defense ranks 25th. The model favors Carolina at 55%, mostly on rushing matchup (3.1 pts) and offensive injuries (1.4 pts).
